verdict.rationale: Retell's own docs describe first-party webhooks that push call_started, call_ended and call_analyzed events to your server in real time, so a program can react without polling. The pack does not document how a consumer registers or subscribes an endpoint, or how deliveries are signed and retried, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/subscription mechanism (account vs per-agent URL configuration), event-type filtering, signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications about events that occur in your Retell AI account.
call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling.
webhooks push data to your application as events happen, making your integrations more efficient and responsive.
